scope: Metadata and official links only; includes the catalogue types and series returned by the source.
identity: rowNum is the unique source record ordinal; retain mevzuatTuru, mevzuatTertip and kanunNo when joining acts.
dates: Dates are verbatim source metadata, not an assertion of commencement. 01.01.0001 is an undated source sentinel.
nulls: JSON null is represented by an empty CSV field.
status: yururlulukDurumu and ilgaTuru are the official source codes, retained without interpretation.

files.law-index-*.csv: All original source fields in source order, in batches of at most 1000 records.
files.rg-links.csv: Every official index record, including empty gazette links.
files.repeal-map.csv: Every official index record, including absent repeal relationships.
